package p

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestPass(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("bad")
	}
}

func TestFail(t *testing.T) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("Add(1, 2) = %d, want 4", Add(1, 2))
	}
}

func TestPanic(t *testing.T) {
	var m map[string]int
	m["x"] = 1
}

func TestSkip(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip("not here")
}

func TestHang(t *testing.T) {
	time.Sleep(time.Hour)
}
